name: garmin-mcp
description: Connect Claude to Garmin Connect China or international fitness and health data. Access activities, training metrics, sleep, HRV, workouts, and more.
long_description:
This MCP server bridges Claude to your personal Garmin Connect data via the garminconnect Python library and includes authentication compatibility for Garmin Connect China.

**Capabilities:**
- Activities: list, detail, splits, laps, heart-rate zones, weather
- Health: steps, sleep, stress, body battery, HRV, SpO2, respiration
- Training: readiness, load trends (CTL/ATL/TSB), VO2 max trend, power zones
- Workouts: upload, schedule, download, bulk operations
- Body: weight, body composition, weigh-ins
- Gear, badges, challenges, nutrition logging
- Advanced cycling: FIT file analysis, DI2 shift data, Power Duration Curve

**First-time setup:** After installing this extension you must authenticate once by running `garmin-mcp-auth` in a terminal (see README). Enable the China account option both during authentication and in this extension when using garmin.cn. Tokens are saved and valid for ~6 months.

token_path.title: Token storage directory
token_path.description: Directory where your Garmin OAuth tokens are stored. You must run garmin-mcp-auth once in a terminal to generate these tokens before using the server.

garmin_is_cn.title: Garmin Connect China account
garmin_is_cn.description: Enable for accounts and data hosted on garmin.cn. Leave disabled for international Garmin Connect accounts.

garmin_email.title: Garmin email (optional)
garmin_email.description: Your Garmin Connect email address. Leave blank if you have already run garmin-mcp-auth.

garmin_password.title: Garmin password (optional)
garmin_password.description: Your Garmin Connect password. Leave blank if you have already run garmin-mcp-auth.
